about_title: Hydraulic pipe benders to Ø8-5/8″, and the machines around them
about_text: CSM's hydraulic benders put the force of a hydraulic bend arm, clamp, pressure die and booster on heavy-wall tube and pipe: the TSR / TDR CNC benders with a servo carriage and collet bend pipe to Ø8-5/8″ on 20 ft mandrels; the TSRJ / TDRJ and TNCPB are the NC versions with servo or manual feed; the TNCB is the single-axis NC pipe bender to Ø8-5/8″; the F38 / F50 bend both ends of a tube at once. The EF, REF and ER machines form, groove and chamfer the tube ends, and the CT325 saws tube and bundles to Ø4″ with servo feed — the stations of a complete tube cell.

Chiao Sheng Machinery (CSM) has built tube benders in Tainan, Taiwan, since 1982 and released its first CNC bender in 1989; the company works from two plants in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, holds 24 international design patents, has been ISO 9001 certified since 2002 and CE-certifies every machine. NovoTech sells, installs and supports CSM machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
